title_en: 5 Missions That Define The C-17 Globemaster's Impressive Airlifting Career
title_zh: 定义 C-17 Globemaster 令人印象深刻的空运生涯的 5 项任务
summary: The most extreme missions the mighty jet has ever pulled off.
summary_zh: 这架强大的喷气式飞机曾经完成过最极端的任务。
body_en: 5 Missions That Define The C-17 Globemaster's Impressive Airlifting Career

Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

The McDonnell Douglas C-17 Globemaster III was designed as the ultimate middle ground between the Lockheed C-5 Galaxy's strategic heavy lift and C-130 Hercules' rugged performance. The jet was made to drop M1 Abrams tanks, paratroopers, and Apache helicopters on 'direct delivery' missions unlike any other plane in the world.

The jet has been one of the most valuable strategic tools in the US Air Force's arsenal since it debuted in 1991. With four powerful Pratt & Whitney F117 engines and unique 'externally blown' titanium flaps, it delivers nonstop intercontinental flights from the heartland to the front line.

Although the Globemaster was built to master the art of dropping troops into battle, some of its most historic moments came during humanitarian relief, disaster evacuation, and scientific support missions. From the permafrost of Antarctica to the Sands of Iraq, the C-17 has proven to be the indispensable backbone of America's global airlift fleet time and time again.
The largest paratrooper drop in the history of C-17 combat operations

In many ways, the execution of operation Northern Delay on March 26, 2003 , is considered a watershed moment for modern air mobility tactics and strategy. This was the first time the C-17 conducted a large-formation combat airdrop in real-world conditions. The mission validated the Globemaster's core design principles and tactical purpose in a 21st-century context.

The Pentagon needed to insert the 173rd Airborne Brigade into northern Iraq to secure Bashur Airfield, effectively tying down six Iraqi divisions and preventing them from reinforcing Baghdad against the main coalition advance from the south. While the aircraft is celebrated globally for its modern humanitarian utility, this operation in the opening days of the Iraq War was exactly what McDonnell Douglas engineers built it to do.

This was the first time in aviation history that a strategic brigade-sized combat airdrop was conducted using C-17s. A 17-strong fleet was assembled at Aviano Air Base in Italy, drawn from the active-duty 62nd and 437th Airlift Wings alongside the reserve 315th and 446th Airlift Wings. The aircraft took off into the night, flying a complex low-altitude route to penetrate Iraqi airspace.

The fleet took off at night in a tight formation, with lights blacked out, relying entirely on night-vision goggles and specialized formation-flight instrumentation. Escorted by a strike package of F-14s, F-18s, and EA-6B Prowlers, the C-17s executed a low-altitude mass tactical drop. Within minutes, 996 paratroopers were on the ground to reinforce the special forces that had spearheaded the airfield takeover.

Over the next two weeks, the C-17s ran continuous air-bridge flights, airlifting an armored battalion onto the site. The aircraft landed on a single 6,700-foot runway carrying heavy payloads, including M1A1 Abrams tanks and M2 Bradley infantry fighting vehicles. Total mission metrics climbed to 2,175 personnel, 408 vehicles, and over 3,000 tons of heavy cargo delivered directly to the frontline.
Transforming an extreme itinerary into a regularly scheduled flight

One of the C-17's least dramatic, yet technically challenging, missions is moving scientists and supplies to McMurdo Station. While the task itself is mundane, very few aircraft in the world can reach the US' primary research facility in Antarctica. Jets from Washington state fly from Christchurch, New Zealand, every southern summer.

The C-5 made history when it touched down in Antarctica in 1989. But the colossal jet is prohibitively expensive to fly, and the operating environment strains both the plane and the airfield, increasing the risk of hazards. The C-17 is essentially the perfect 'Goldilocks' airframe for the mission: it doesn't push the envelope as much as a C-5, but it can deliver far more than a C-130 in a single sortie.

By blowing the hot jet exhaust directly through and over the double-slotted titanium flaps, the C-17 effectively doubles the wing's lift compared to an airliner. As a result, a massive C-17 can slow down to an approach speed of just 115 to 130 knots. The blown flap system works hand in hand with the C-17's unique upward-directed thrust reversers, making it not only possible but much safer than landing any other airplane on the sea-ice runway at McMurdo's Phoenix Airfield.

At roughly 290 tons maximum takeoff weight, the C-17 is significantly lighter than a C-5, yet it features a highly sophisticated 14-wheel landing gear system. The main landing gear features two six-wheel bogies to spread the plane's weight across a wide area, drastically reducing ground pressure. Globemaster aircrews deliver over 100,000 pounds (45,359 kg) of scientific gear and personnel per flight.
3 Operation Unified Response: Earthquake Relief In Haiti
Bringing the airfield to the runway and delivering lifesaving cargo from the sky

When the capital city of Haiti was brought down by a devastating earthquake in 2010, airborne relief efforts were bottlenecked by the damage to Port-au-Prince International Airport. With just one functional runway, standard operations with conventional air freighters would have slowed the delivery of rescue teams and relief supplies to a crawl. The C-17's outstanding short-field performance once again let it circumvent this bottleneck in humanitarian efforts.

In a typical disaster zone, an airport becomes congested not because planes cannot land, but because they cannot leave the runway. Most large aircraft require a ground-based tug vehicle to push them backward out of a parking spot or a wide taxiway to turn around. With Port-au-Prince crippled, ground equipment was virtually non-existent.
body_zh: 定义 C-17 Globemaster 令人印象深刻的空运生涯的 5 项任务
卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
麦道 C-17 Globemaster III 被设计为洛克希德 C-5 Galaxy 的战略重型运输机和 C-130 Hercules 的坚固性能之间的终极中间地带。与世界上任何其他飞机不同，这架飞机可以执行“直接投送”任务，投掷 M1 艾布拉姆斯坦克、伞兵和阿帕奇直升机。
自 1991 年首次亮相以来，该喷气式飞机一直是美国空军武器库中最有价值的战略工具之一。它拥有四台强大的普惠 F117 发动机和独特的“外吹”钛合金襟翼，可提供从腹地到前线的不间断洲际航班。
尽管环球霸王是为了掌握将部队投入战斗的艺术而建造的，但它最具历史意义的一些时刻还是在人道主义救援、灾难疏散和科学支持任务期间。从南极洲的永久冻土到伊拉克的沙地，C-17 一次又一次被证明是美国全球空运机队不可或缺的支柱。
C-17作战行动史上最大规模的伞兵空投
从很多方面来说，2003 年 3 月 26 日执行的“北方延迟”行动被认为是现代空中机动战术和战略的分水岭时刻。这是C-17首次在现实条件下进行大编队战斗空投。该任务验证了环球霸王在 21 世纪背景下的核心设计原则和战术目的。
五角大楼需要将第 173 空降旅部署到伊拉克北部，以确保巴舒尔机场的安全，从而有效地束缚伊拉克的 6 个师，并阻止他们增援巴格达，抵御来自南部的联军主力进攻。虽然这架飞机因其现代人道主义用途而享誉全球，但在伊拉克战争初期的这次行动正是麦道工程师建造它的目的。
这是航空史上首次使用 C-17 进行战略旅规模的战斗空投。一支 17 人的机队在意大利阿维亚诺空军基地集结，来自现役第 62 和第 437 空运联队以及预备役的第 315 和 446 空运联队。飞机在夜间起飞，飞行了一条复杂的低空航线，穿透伊拉克领空。
机队在夜间以紧密编队起飞，灯光熄灭，完全依靠夜视镜和专门的编队飞行仪表。在 F-14、F-18 和 EA-6B 徘徊者攻击机的护航下，C-17 执行了低空大规模战术空投。几分钟之内，996 名伞兵就抵达地面，增援带头占领机场的特种部队。
在接下来的两周里，C-17 进行了连续的空中飞行，将一个装甲营空运到现场。飞机降落在一条 6,700 英尺的跑道上，载有重型有效载荷，包括 M1A1 艾布拉姆斯坦克和 M2 布拉德利步兵战车。任务总指标攀升至 2,175 名人员、408 辆车辆以及直接运送到前线的 3,000 多吨重型货物。
将极端行程转变为定期航班
C-17 最不起眼但技术上具有挑战性的任务之一是将科学家和物资运送到麦克默多站。虽然任务本身很平凡，但世界上很少有飞机能够到达美国在南极洲的主要研究设施。每年南方夏季，华盛顿州都有飞机从新西兰基督城起飞。
C-5 于 1989 年在南极洲着陆，创造了历史。但这种巨型喷气式飞机的飞行成本高得令人望而却步，而且运行环境给飞机和机场带来了压力，增加了发生危险的风险。 C-17 本质上是执行该任务的完美“金发姑娘”机身：它不像 C-5 那样挑战极限，但它在一次出击中可以提供远远超过 C-130 的能力。
通过将热喷气废气直接吹过双槽钛制襟翼，C-17 与客机相比，有效地将机翼升力加倍。因此，大型 C-17 的接近速度只能减至 115 至 130 节。吹动襟翼系统与 C-17 独特的向上推力反向器协同工作，使其不仅可以在麦克默多凤凰城机场的海冰跑道上着陆，而且比任何其他飞机着陆都安全得多。
C-17 的最大起飞重量约为 290 吨，比 C-5 轻得多，但它具有高度复杂的 14 轮起落架系统。主起落架具有两个六轮转向架，可将飞机的重量分散到较大的区域，从而大大降低地面压力。 Globemaster 机组人员每次飞行运送超过 100,000 磅（45,359 公斤）的科学装备和人员。
3 统一响应行动：海地抗震救灾
将机场带到跑道并从空中运送救生货物
2010 年，海地首都遭遇毁灭性地震，太子港国际机场受损，导致空降救援工作陷入瓶颈。如果只有一条正常运行的跑道，传统货机的标准操作会减慢救援队和救援物资的运送速度。 C-17出色的短程性能再次使其绕过了人道主义救援的这一瓶颈。
在典型的灾区，机场变得拥挤并不是因为飞机无法降落，而是因为它们无法离开跑道。大多数大型飞机需要地面拖车将其向后推出停车位或宽阔的滑行道才能掉头。由于太子港瘫痪，地面设备几乎不存在。

title_en: Transfer Citi ThankYou Points To Cathay Pacific With 10% Bonus: Worth It?
title_zh: 将花旗感谢积分转移至国泰航空并享受 10% 奖励：值得吗？
summary: Citi ThankYou is offering a 10% transfer bonus to Cathay Pacific in the US. It's not huge, but it's rare, and best suited to booking Cathay Pacific premium cabins.
summary_zh: CitiThankYou 向美国国泰航空提供 10% 的转账奖金。虽然不大，但是很少见，最适合订国泰公务
body_en: The Citi ThankYou program in the United States has just introduced a new transfer bonus to Cathay Pacific. While it’s not a particularly large percentage bonus, it is a rare offer, as I don’t remember the last time we saw an offer like this between the programs on Citi’s end. This offer is better than nothing, and Cathay Pacific’s program is best if you want to redeem directly for flights on the airline.
Citi ThankYou to Cathay Pacific transfer bonus promotion
Between October 25 and November 14, 2026, the Citi ThankYou program in the United States is offering a 10% bonus on points transfers to Cathay Pacific.

Ordinarily points transfer at a 1:1 ratio (in 1,000 point increments, assuming you have a premium Citi ThankYou card), while through this promotion you’d get 1,100 Cathay Pacific miles for every 1,000 Citi ThankYou points transferred.

There are several great cards earning Citi ThankYou points , including the Citi Strata Premier® Card ( learn more ) and Citi Strata Elite℠ Card ( learn more ), and it’s easy to combine points between the cards .

I should mention that in the past we’ve sometimes seen Cathay Pacific offer a bonus on points transfers from partners, but that was always on Cathay Pacific’s end, and not on Citi’s end. When we saw one of those offers, the transfer bonus wasn’t instant, so that wasn’t nearly as useful as this, in my opinion.

Cathay Pacific’s program partners with Amex Membership Rewards, Bilt Rewards, Capital One, and Citi ThankYou. All points transfers are 1:1, except Amex, which only has a 5:4 transfer ratio. For what it’s worth, Cathay Pacific miles expire after 18 months of inactivity. Any mileage earning or redemption opportunity would reset that timeline.
Is this Cathay Pacific transfer bonus worth it?
The Cathay Pacific Asia Miles program is one that has become increasingly useful over time, even though it’s one I historically haven’t really liked.

The single biggest thing to be aware of is that while Cathay Pacific belongs to the oneworld alliance, Cathay Pacific restricts a vast majority of its first and business class award space to members of the Asia Miles program, so that award space isn’t bookable through programs like Alaska Atmos Rewards and American AAdvantage . That didn’t used to be the case, and it’s the single biggest way that the value of this currency has improved.

There are also some situations where partner redemptions represent a good deal, though I’d say they’re the exception rather than the norm. For example, one valuable partner sweet spot of the program is that when booking through Asia Miles, British Airways flights have lower carrier imposed surcharges than through other programs.
Still, I’d say the primary value here is if you actually want to redeem for travel on Cathay Pacific in a premium cabin, since this is the most practical way to book that.

Through November 14, 2026, Citi ThankYou is offering a 10% bonus on points transfers to Cathay Pacific. While a 10% bonus isn’t huge, it’s better than nothing, and transfer bonuses to Cathay Pacific are incredibly rare. I definitely wouldn’t make a speculative transfer to take advantage of this, but if you’re going to move points anyway, you might as well get a bonus!

To be honest, I’m sort of tempted by this offer. I’d like to fly Cathay Pacific’s current first class one more time before it’s retired, particularly to check out Cathay Pacific’s new first class lounge , which still isn’t open to non-Cathay Pacific oneworld Emeralds.
Do you plan on taking advantage of this Citi to Cathay Pacific transfer bonus?
body_zh: 美国的花旗感谢计划刚刚推出了国泰航空的新转会奖金。虽然这不是一个特别大的百分比奖金，但这是一个罕见的优惠，因为我不记得我们上次在花旗的项目之间看到这样的优惠是什么时候。这个优惠总比没有好，如果您想直接兑换航空公司的航班，国泰航空的计划是最好的选择。
花旗感谢国泰航空转乘奖金促销
2026年10月25日至11月14日期间，美国的花旗ThankYou计划为将积分转移至国泰航空提供10%的奖励。
一般情况下，积分转让比例为 1:1（以 1,000 积分为增量，假设您拥有高级花旗感谢卡），而通过此促销活动，每转让 1,000 点花旗感谢积分，即可获得 1,100 国泰航空里程。
有几张很棒的卡可赚取 CitiThankYou 积分，包括 Citi Strata Premier® 卡（了解更多）和 Citi Strata Elite℠ 卡（了解更多），并且可以轻松合并卡之间的积分。
我应该提一下，过去我们有时会看到国泰航空对合作伙伴的积分转让提供奖励，但那总是国泰航空这边，而不是花旗那边。当我们看到其中一项优惠时，转会奖金并不是即时的，所以在我看来，这并不像这个那么有用。
国泰航空的计划与美国运通会员奖励 (Amex Membership Rewards)、Bilt Rewards、第一资本 (Capital One) 和花旗感谢 (CitiThankYou) 合作。所有的积分转移都是1:1，除了Amex，它只有5:4的转移比例。无论如何，国泰航空里程在闲置 18 个月后就会过期。任何里程赚取或兑换机会都会重置该时间表。
国泰航空转机奖金值得吗？
随着时间的推移，国泰航空的“亚洲万里通”计划变得越来越有用，尽管我一直不太喜欢它。
最需要注意的一点是，虽然国泰航空属于 oneworld 联盟，但国泰航空将其绝大多数头等舱和商务舱奖励空间限制为“亚洲万里通”计划的会员，因此无法通过阿拉斯加 Atmos Rewards 和美国 AAdvantage 等计划预订奖励空间。过去情况并非如此，这是该货币价值提高的唯一最大方式。
在某些情况下，合作伙伴兑换也很划算，尽管我想说它们是例外而不是常态。例如，该计划的一个有价值的合作伙伴优势是，通过亚洲万里通预订英国航空航班时，承运商征收的附加费比通过其他计划低。
不过，我想说，这里的主要价值是，如果您真的想兑换国泰航空的高级舱位旅行，因为这是最实用的预订方式。
截至 2026 年 11 月 14 日，CitiThankYou 为将积分转移至国泰航空提供 10% 的奖励。虽然 10% 的奖金不算多，但总比没有好，而且转入国泰航空的奖金非常罕见。我绝对不会利用这一点进行投机性转移，但如果你无论如何都要转移积分，你不妨获得奖金！
说实话，我有点被这个提议所吸引。我想在国泰航空目前的头等舱退役之前再乘坐一次，特别是去看看国泰航空新的头等舱休息室，该休息室仍然不对非国泰航空 oneworld Emeralds 开放。

title_en: Alaska Atmos Rewards Ascent Card Review: Big Bonus, Great Benefits
title_zh: 阿拉斯加Atmos奖励上升卡评论：大奖金，大福利
summary: The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card offers up to 80,000 points, a $99 companion fare, and perks like free checked bags for just a $95 annual fee. Here's my take.
summary_zh: Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡可提供高达 80,000 点积分、99 美元的同伴票价以及免费托运行李等福利，年费仅为 95 美元。这是我的
body_en: The Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® credit card is the mid-range personal credit card of Atmos Rewards, which is the loyalty program of Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines. This card is issued by Bank of America, and represents a great value. If you fly Alaska or Hawaiian with any frequency, this is a card you’ll probably want to pick up.

There are many reasons to consider picking up this card , especially if you fly Alaska or Hawaiian with any frequency. This post is my in-depth review of the Atmos Rewards Ascent Card, so let’s take a look at the card’s value proposition, for anyone who may be considering applying. This is an especially good time to apply, given the welcome offer that’s currently available.
Link: Learn more about the Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® credit card
Atmos Rewards Ascent Card summary & key details
Before I get into my Atmos Rewards Ascent Card review, here’s a brief summary of the key details of the card
Atmos Ascent Card welcome offer: Up to 80,000 Atmos Rewards points plus a $99 companion fare upon completing minimum spending

Atmos Ascent Card rewards earn rate: 3x Atmos Rewards points on Alaska & Hawaiian purchases, 2x points on eligible gas, EV charging stations, cable, streaming services, and local transit purchases (including rideshare), and 1x points on all other purchases; also earn one status point for every $3 spent, with no cap
Atmos Ascent Card benefits & credits: First checked bag free on Alaska & Hawaiian, preferred boarding on Alaska & Hawaiian flights, a $99 companion fare with $6,000 in annual spending, and more
Atmos Ascent Card foreign transaction fees: None
Atmos Ascent Card best for: Someone who flies Alaska and/or Hawaiian occasionally, and values perks like a free checked bag and preferred boarding
Below are what I consider to be the pros and cons of the Atmos Rewards Ascent Card .

Atmos Rewards Ascent Card pros Atmos Rewards Ascent Card cons Generous welcome bonus No airport lounge access Ability to earn $99 companion fare Not the best card for everyday spending Solid perks for travel on Alaska & Hawaiian No useful travel protections Atmos Ascent Card bonus, eligibility, & fee basics

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card is the more basic personal card in the Atmos Rewards ecosystem. To start, let’s cover the welcome bonus, eligibility rules, and annual fee, since these are things that many cardmembers may be considering.
Welcome bonus of up to 80K points & $99 companion fare

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card is offering a limited time welcome bonus where you’ll receive up to 80,000 bonus points and a $99 companion fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) with this offer. You’ll get 60,000 bonus points plus a $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) after spending $3,000 or more on purchases within the first 90 days of opening your account. You can then earn an additional 20,000 bonus points after spending a total of $5,000 or more on purchases within the same 90-day period.

Based on my latest miles & points valuations , Atmos Rewards points are worth 1.5 cents each, given all the great uses there are of them . That means the 80,000 points are worth $1,200 for me. That doesn’t even account for the value of the companion fare, which could save you hundreds of dollars.

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card is issued by Bank of America. The good news is that eligibility for this card is unrelated to having any other Atmos Rewards card, so you’re eligible for this card (including the bonus) if you have the business version of the card, the Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card ( learn more ), or the premium version of the card, the Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card ( learn more ).

Bank of America doesn’t have too many consistent restrictions when it comes to getting approved for cards. The most consistent rule is that you can typically only be approved at most two Bank of America card in a two month period, three Bank of America cards in a 12 month period, and four Bank of America cards in a 24 month period (this applies to personal cards, not business cards).

There’s no consistent credit score you need in order to get approved for the Atmos Rewards Ascent Card. In general, I’d hope to have a score in the “good” to “excellent” range, ideally 700+ points. However, people with lower scores have been approved, and people with higher scores have been rejected.

The Atmos Rewards Ascent Card has a reasonable $95 annual fee. At right under $100, that’s in line with the annual fees you’ll find on many co-branded airline credit cards. You can add authorized users to the card at no extra cost (and there’s a reason you may want to do so, as I’ll cover below).

考虑购买这张卡的原因有很多，特别是如果您以任何频率乘坐阿拉斯加或夏威夷航班。这篇文章是我对 Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡的深入评论，所以让我们为任何可能考虑申请的人看一下该卡的价值主张。鉴于目前提供的欢迎优惠，这是一个特别好的申请时机。
链接：了解有关 Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® 信用卡的更多信息
Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡摘要和关键详细信息
在我开始评论 Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡之前，先简要介绍一下该卡的关键细节
Atmos Ascent 卡迎新优惠：完成最低消费即可获得高达 80,000 Atmos 奖励积分以及 99 美元的同伴票价

Atmos Ascent 卡优惠和积分：阿拉斯加和夏威夷航空的首件行李免费托运、阿拉斯加和夏威夷航空的优先登机、年度消费满 6,000 美元的同伴票价为 99 美元，等等
Atmos Ascent 卡国外交易费用：无
Atmos Ascent 卡最适合：偶尔乘坐阿拉斯加和/或夏威夷航班并重视免费托运行李和优先登机等福利的人士
以下是我认为 Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡的优点和缺点。
Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡的优点 Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡的缺点 慷慨的欢迎奖金 无法使用机场贵宾室 能够赚取 99 美元的同伴票价 不是日常消费的最佳卡 在阿拉斯加和夏威夷旅行的稳定福利 没有有用的旅行保护 Atmos Ascent 卡的奖金、资格和费用基础知识
Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡是 Atmos Rewards 生态系统中更基本的个人卡。首先，让我们介绍一下欢迎奖金、资格规则和年费，因为这些是许多持卡会员可能会考虑的事情。
高达 80K 积分的欢迎奖金和 99 美元的同伴票价

Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡提供限时欢迎奖金，您将获得高达 80,000 点奖励积分和 99 美元的同伴票价（加上 23 美元起的税费）。在开设帐户后的前 90 天内消费满 3,000 美元或以上，您将获得 60,000 点奖励积分以及 99 美元的同伴票价（另加 23 美元起的税费）。在同一 90 天内购买商品总计 5,000 美元或以上后，您可以额外赚取 20,000 点奖励积分。
根据我最新的里程和积分估值，Atmos 奖励积分每张价值 1.5 美分，因为它们有很多用途。这意味着 80,000 点积分对我来说价值 1,200 美元。这甚至没有考虑同伴票价的价值，这可以为您节省数百美元。
Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡由美国银行发行。好消息是，这张卡的资格与拥有任何其他 Atmos Rewards 卡无关，因此，如果您拥有该卡的商务版 Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® 商务卡（了解更多信息）或该卡的高级版 Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® 信用卡（了解更多信息），您就有资格获得这张卡（包括奖金）。
美国银行在获得信用卡批准方面没有太多一致的限制。最一致的规则是，您通常在两个月内最多只能批准两张美国银行卡，在 12 个月内最多只能批准三张美国银行卡，在 24 个月内最多只能批准四张美国银行卡（这适用于个人卡，不适用于名片）。
您不需要一致的信用评分即可获得 Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡的批准。总的来说，我希望得分在“好”到“优秀”的范围内，最好是700分以上。然而，分数较低的人已被批准，而分数较高的人已被拒绝。
Atmos Rewards Ascent 卡的年费合理，为 95 美元。费用不到 100 美元，与许多联名航空公司信用卡的年费一致。您可以将授权用户添加到卡中，无需额外费用（您可能想要这样做是有原因的，我将在下面介绍）。

title_en: The Hidden Math Behind The Boeing 787's Legendary Long-Haul Passenger Experience
title_zh: 波音 787 传奇长途乘客体验背后隐藏的数学原理
summary: What makes the passenger experience on the Boeing 787 so special? The Dreamliner set the bar incredibly high and continues to shape aircraft design
summary_zh: 是什么让波音 787 的乘客体验如此特别？梦想飞机设定了令人难以置信的高标准，并继续塑造飞机设计
body_en: The Hidden Math Behind The Boeing 787's Legendary Long-Haul Passenger Experience
Airline and Airport Management Graduate, Student Commercial Pilot and Commercial Aviation Writer.

Commercial aircraft engineering has largely been defined by mechanical efficiency: range, fuel burn per seat-mile, payload capacity, and engine thrust. Boeing set out to design the 787 Dreamliner in the early 2000s, and the manufacturer shifted the design baseline toward human physiology. Recognizing that long-haul travel places immense strain on the human body, Boeing’s engineers sought to use advanced materials and systems to actively mitigate jet lag, dehydration, and high-altitude fatigue.

The resulting passenger experience is defined by a 6,000-foot cabin altitude, a 9.06 psi pressure differential, 25% relative humidity, and windows 65% larger than industry standards. However, this physiological equation carries a notable commercial trade-off. While carbon-fiber composites and smart flight controls create one of the healthiest atmospheric environments in the sky, economic realities in the economy cabin work directly against those spatial metrics.

On conventional aluminum airframes, such as the 767 or Airbus A330 , maximum cabin altitude at a typical cruising altitude of 40,000 feet is capped at approximately 8,000 feet above sea level. Boeing set the 787's maximum cabin altitude significantly lower, holding the interior environment at approximately 6,000 feet . This adjustment requires a maximum structural pressure differential (ΔP) of roughly 9.06 pounds per square inch (psi), compared to the 8.11 psi typical of legacy aluminum jets.

The decision to target a 6,000-foot cabin environment was directly informed by medical research. A landmark study published in the New England Journal of Medicine evaluated human physiological responses across extended flight durations and found that after three to nine hours at a simulated cabin altitude of 8,000 feet, blood oxygen saturation SpO2 dropped by an average of 4.4 percentage points compared to ground-level baselines. The drop in blood oxygen saturation triggers the classic symptoms of long-haul travel fatigue, including headaches, cognitive sluggishness, and muscle aches. On the 787, blood oxygen levels are kept significantly closer to sea-level norms all through that 6,000 feet cabin altitude, directly reducing post-flight exhaustion.

Sustaining an internal pressure of 9.06 psi without exceeding the structural fatigue limits of the airframe requires advanced materials. Traditional riveted aluminum fuselages expand and contract under cyclic pressurization, making high-pressure differentials a primary driver of metal fatigue and cracking over thousands of flight hours. The 787 solves this by utilizing carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) composites for roughly 50% of its airframe by weight , including the main fuselage barrel sections. Carbon fiber's high tensile strength and fatigue resistance allow the hull to withstand higher internal pressure stresses without structural degradation.

Alongside cabin altitude, relative humidity plays a pivotal role in inflight comfort. On conventional jetliners, cabin air is supplied by bleed air extracted directly from the compressor stages of the jet engines. Air at 35,000 feet contains virtually no moisture, and because traditional aluminum fuselages are highly susceptible to corrosion caused by condensation, a phenomenon known in aerospace engineering as cabin rain. Other airliners intentionally restrict cabin humidity to under 10%, which causes mucosal dehydration, dry eyes, and heightened fatigue during transoceanic flights, according to TravelGrom .

The 787 removes this constraint through a bleedless engine design . Instead of piping hot compressor air from the engines into the cabin, the Dreamliner uses dedicated, electrically driven compressors to draw fresh outside air directly into the environmental control system. A composite CFRP airframe is completely immune to rust and moisture corrosion, so Boeing equips the 787 with active cabin humidifiers, pushing relative humidity levels up to 15% to 25%.

As Simple Flying previously explored , the move to electric compressors also improves air purity. As a result of disconnecting the cabin air supply from the engine oil seals, the 787 entirely takes away the risk of synthetic engine oil fumes entering the passenger deck during severe seal wear, ensuring a cleaner, more consistent breathing environment.

Looking from the inside, the most visually prominent feature of the 787 cabin is its window design. Measuring 10.7 by 18.4 inches, the Dreamliner’s windows are up to 65% larger than standard passenger aircraft windows , matching the vertical viewing dimensions of classic airliners like the Douglas DC-8 . The size and positioning ensure that passengers seated anywhere in the cabin, including middle seats, maintain a direct line-of-sight view to the horizon.

Rather than relying on traditional plastic pull-down shades, the 787 adopts electrochromic dimming technology supplied by Gentex . Embedded within the window assembly is an electrified gel layer containing light-absorbing particles. When flight crews or passengers adjust the control buttons beneath the window, small electric currents alter the alignment of these particles across five distinct opacity levels, transitioning from fully transparent to a deep blue dim state.

These electrochromic windows block over 99.99% of visible light and thermal infrared energy in their darkest setting, keeping the cabin cool under direct sunlight without blocking the view outside entirely. Additionally, as noted in Simple Flying flight deck operational guides covering aircraft where cabin crew controls the view, flight attendants can centrally override individual window settings via the Cabin Services System (CSS) panel, ensuring all windows are instantly undimmed during takeoff, landing, or emergency situations to maintain external situational awareness.

Inflight turbulence is one of the leading contributors to passenger anxiety and motion sickness. To create a noticeably smoother cabin experience, Boeing combined the natural structural elasticity of high-aspect-ratio carbon wings with an automated, sensor-driven active flight control system known as Smooth Ride Technology . Unlike older aircraft that react only after turbulence displacements pass through the airframe, the 787 uses flush-mounted pressure sensors embedded in its nose cone to detect incoming vertical wind gusts milliseconds before they strike the lifting surfaces . The flight control computers process these pressure differentials instantly, calculating precise counteracting control surface adjustments.
body_zh: 波音 787 传奇长途乘客体验背后隐藏的数学原理
航空公司和机场管理毕业生、商业飞行员学生和商业航空作家。
商用飞机工程在很大程度上是由机械效率来定义的：航程、每座英里的燃油消耗、有效载荷能力和发动机推力。波音公司于 2000 年代初开始设计 787 梦想飞机，制造商将设计基线转向人体生理学。波音公司的工程师认识到长途旅行会给人体带来巨大的压力，因此寻求使用先进的材料和系统来积极缓解时差、脱水和高海拔疲劳。
由此产生的乘客体验由 6,000 英尺的机舱高度、9.06 psi 的压差、25% 的相对湿度以及比行业标准大 65% 的窗户来定义。然而，这个生理方程带来了显着的商业权衡。虽然碳纤维复合材料和智能飞行控制系统创造了天空中最健康的大气环境之一，但经济舱中的经济现实直接与这些空间指标相悖。
在传统的铝制机身上，例如 767 或空客 A330，在 40,000 英尺的典型巡航高度下，最大客舱高度上限为海拔约 8,000 英尺。波音将 787 的最大客舱高度设置得较低，将内部环境保持在约 6,000 英尺。这种调整需要大约 9.06 磅每平方英寸 (psi) 的最大结构压差 (ΔP)，而传统铝制喷嘴的典型压差为 8.11 psi。

以 6,000 英尺高的机舱环境为目标的决定是直接根据医学研究得出的。 《新英格兰医学杂志》发表的一项具有里程碑意义的研究评估了长时间飞行期间的人类生理反应，发现在 8,000 英尺的模拟机舱高度三到九小时后，血氧饱和度 SpO2 与地面基线相比平均下降 4.4 个百分点。血氧饱和度下降会引发长途旅行疲劳的典型症状，包括头痛、认知迟缓和肌肉酸痛。在 787 飞机上，在 6,000 英尺的机舱高度上，血氧水平始终保持在显着接近海平面标准的水平，从而直接减少了飞行后的疲劳。
维持 9.06 psi 的内部压力而不超过机身的结构疲劳极限需要先进的材料。传统的铆接铝机身在循环加压下膨胀和收缩，使得高压差成为数千飞行小时中金属疲劳和开裂的主要驱动因素。 787 的机身重量约 50%（包括机身主体部分）采用了碳纤维增强聚合物 (CFRP) 复合材料，从而解决了这一问题。碳纤维的高拉伸强度和抗疲劳性使船体能够承受更高的内压应力而不会导致结构退化。
除了机舱高度之外，相对湿度对于机上舒适度也起着至关重要的作用。在传统的喷气式客机上，机舱空气由直接从喷气发动机的压缩机级抽取的引气提供。 35,000 英尺的空气几乎不含水分，因为传统的铝制机身非常容易受到冷凝引起的腐蚀，这种现象在航空航天工程中被称为机舱雨。 TravelGrom 表示，其他航空公司有意将机舱湿度限制在 10% 以下，这会导致跨洋飞行期间粘膜脱水、眼睛干涩和疲劳加剧。
787 通过无泄气发动机设计消除了这一限制。梦想客机没有将热压缩机空气从发动机输送到机舱，而是使用专用的电动压缩机将新鲜的外部空气直接吸入环境控制系统。复合 CFRP 机身完全不受生锈和湿气腐蚀的影响，因此波音为 787 配备了主动机舱加湿器，将相对湿度水平提高至 15% 至 25%。
正如 Simple Flying 之前探索的那样，改用电动压缩机还可以提高空气纯度。由于将机舱空气供应与发动机油封断开，787 完全消除了密封件严重磨损期间合成发动机油烟进入乘客甲板的风险，确保了更清洁、更一致的呼吸环境。
从内部看，787客舱视觉上最突出的特点就是窗户设计。梦想飞机的窗户尺寸为 10.7 x 18.4 英寸，比标准客机窗户大 65%，与道格拉斯 DC-8 等经典客机的垂直观看尺寸相匹配。尺寸和位置确保坐在机舱内任何位置（包括中间座位）的乘客都能直接看到地平线。
787 没有采用传统的塑料下拉式遮阳帘，而是采用 Gentex 提供的电致变色调光技术。窗户组件内嵌有一层含有光吸收颗粒的带电凝胶层。当机组人员或乘客调整窗户下方的控制按钮时，小电流会改变这些粒子在五个不同不透明度级别上的排列，从完全透明过渡到深蓝色昏暗状态。
这些电致变色窗户在最黑暗的环境下可阻挡超过 99.99% 的可见光和热红外能量，使机舱在阳光直射下保持凉爽，而不会完全阻挡外面的视野。此外，正如涵盖机组人员控制视野的飞机的简单飞行驾驶舱操作指南中所述，空乘人员可以通过客舱服务系统（CSS）面板集中覆盖各个窗口设置，确保所有窗户在起飞、着陆或紧急情况下立即不变暗，以保持外部态势感知。
飞行中的湍流是导致乘客焦虑和晕动病的主要原因之一。为了创造更加平稳的机舱体验，波音将高展弦比碳翼的自然结构弹性与自动化、传感器驱动的主动飞行控制系统（称为“平滑乘坐技术”）相结合。与仅在湍流位移通过机身后才做出反应的老式飞机不同，787 使用嵌入其鼻锥中的齐平安装压力传感器来检测即将到来的垂直阵风，然后在它们撞击升力面之前几毫秒。飞行控制计算机立即处理这些压力差，计算出精确的抵消控制面调整。

title_en: Boston Logan Looking For Wicked Strong Accent For New Airport Announcements
title_zh: 波士顿洛根为新机场公告寻找邪恶的浓重口音
summary: Boston Logan Airport is searching for a wicked Boston accent. Meet the eight finalists competing to become the airport's new voice.
summary_zh: 波士顿洛根机场正在寻找邪恶的波士顿口音。来认识一下八位决赛入围者，他们竞相成为机场的新代言人。
body_en: Boston Logan Looking For Wicked Strong Accent For New Airport Announcements

Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

Boston Logan International Airport (BOS) is searching for a new voice to welcome travelers, and the ideal candidate needs one unmistakable qualification: a strong Boston accent. The Massachusetts Port Authority (Massport) launched its Voice of Logan competition in September 2026 after passengers said they wanted the airport to better reflect its local identity. Nearly 6,000 people entered the contest, but only eight finalists remain. The public can vote until Wednesday on a dedicated website, and the winner is scheduled to be announced on November 5.

The competition celebrates one of New England's most recognizable cultural characteristics while offering a local resident the opportunity to become part of the airport experience. The selected voice will record announcements that welcome passengers and help create a distinctly Bostonian atmosphere inside the terminals. However, the challenge extends beyond simply dropping the letter 'r' from certain words: contestants must sound authentic while remaining clear enough for international travelers to understand. The initiative also highlights how airports can use local character to distinguish themselves from other major transportation hubs.
Boston Logan Narrows Down Its Search For A New Airport Voice

According to The Wall Street Journal , Massport developed the competition after feedback indicated that certain parts of Logan didn't feel sufficiently connected to Boston. Rich Davey, the authority's chief executive, said the goal was to make the airport feel more authentically local. The contest attracted thousands of applicants through in-person auditions and online submissions, with hopefuls demonstrating their accents using a specially written script featuring Boston landmarks, regional food and local expressions. Judges evaluated entries for clarity, authenticity, and how well they captured the Logan Airport atmosphere.

The final eight contestants represent different backgrounds and communities across Greater Boston. They include Meagan Lewis-Michelson, a musical-theater performer; Christopher Donisi, a pipefitter; Phyllis Thibodeaux Beach, a retired motor vehicle department employee; and Alex Marcin, a third-generation Italian American from East Boston. The remaining finalists are Ashley Cook, a Boston Public Schools teacher; Samantha Edwards, an entrepreneur; Max German, a Boston College law student; and Kristin Ingala, a bartender and boxer who grew up in Boston's North End. Public voting runs from October 24 through October 28 at VoiceofLogan.com, with the winner due to be announced on November 5.

The winner will receive a modest payment for recording the announcements, though the opportunity is primarily about local pride rather than financial reward. The contest gives participants a chance to embrace their roots while competing for a role that could make their voices familiar to millions of passengers .
Thousands Audition To Find Boston’s Most Authentic Accent

The audition script was designed to test contestants' knowledge of Boston and their pronunciation. It referenced lobster rolls, cannoli in the North End, the coastal town of Gloucester, and Fenway Park's famous Green Monster. One particularly important test was pronouncing Gloucester correctly, with Davey emphasizing that the name should sound like "GLOS-tah" when delivered with a pronounced local accent. According to the WSJ report, Sarah Lee, Massport's transportation planning manager, reviewed about 500 recordings and said incorrect pronunciation could expose applicants whose accents didn't sound genuine.

The competition also attracted high-profile contributions and plenty of humor. Massachusetts Senator Ed Markey and former New England Patriots tight end Rob Gronkowski recorded their own versions, while actor Ben Affleck submitted a parody featuring tongue-in-cheek warnings about Boston stereotypes. Meanwhile, voice-over coach and broadcaster Chris Palermo offered contestants some unconventional advice for reproducing the city's characteristic speech patterns. The variety of submissions demonstrates how the Boston accent remains a recognizable part of the region's cultural identity, even as residents have different relationships with it.

Another important consideration is balancing regional identity with the practical requirements of airport communication. Logan serves about 130,000 passengers daily, according to the WSJ report, so clarity is essential amid terminal noise and passenger movement. A distinctive accent can make the airport feel more welcoming and memorable, but visitors unfamiliar with local speech must still understand important instructions. The winning voice must balance personality with intelligibility, without delivering the strongest possible accent.
From Carolyn Hopkins To Logan: The Voices Behind Airport Announcements

Airport announcements often use familiar professional voices rather than individual local personalities. Carolyn Hopkins is one of the best-known examples: the American voice-over artist has recorded announcements for hundreds of transportation facilities and other public venues. As The Points Guy described Hopkins's career, and in an interview with WBUR , her calm, friendly delivery has become familiar to travelers across numerous airports, railway stations, and other public spaces. Her career illustrates how a recorded voice can become an enduring, if largely anonymous, part of the passenger experience.

Logan's approach takes a different direction by deliberately choosing a voice tied to its home city. Rather than prioritizing a standardized announcement style, Massport is inviting the public to choose someone whose accent and personality reflect the surrounding community. The initiative could make routine airport messages feel more distinctive while giving a local resident an unusual opportunity to represent Boston. The winner is expected to begin welcoming travelers around the holiday season later this year.

For Boston, the contest is about more than finding someone to read a script over a public-address system. It is a chance to turn a familiar regional accent into a symbol of civic pride and give Logan a more recognizable local identity. Whether voters favor a subtle accent or a particularly emphatic delivery, the winning voice will soon become part of the soundtrack of one of New England's busiest airports .
body_zh: 波士顿洛根为新机场公告寻找邪恶的浓重口音
经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。

波士顿洛根国际机场 (BOS) 正在寻找新的声音来欢迎旅客，而理想的候选人需要一个明确的资格：浓重的波士顿口音。在乘客表达了希望机场更好地体现其当地特色的愿望后，马萨诸塞州港务局 (Massport) 于 2026 年 9 月启动了“洛根之声”竞赛。近 6,000 人参加了比赛，但最终只剩下 8 名决赛选手。公众投票截止日期为 10 月 28 日，可在专门网站上进行，获胜者计划于 11 月 5 日公布。
该竞赛庆祝了新英格兰最知名的文化特征之一，同时为当地居民提供了成为机场体验一部分的机会。选定的声音将录制欢迎乘客的公告，并有助于在航站楼内营造独特的波士顿氛围。然而，挑战不仅仅是简单地删除某些单词中的字母“r”：参赛者必须听起来真实，同时保持足够清晰，让国际旅行者能够理解。该倡议还强调了机场如何利用当地特色来区别于其他主要交通枢纽。
波士顿洛根缩小了寻找新机场声音的范围
据《华尔街日报》报道，在反馈表明洛根的某些地区与波士顿的联系不够充分后，马萨诸塞州体育局发起了这项竞赛。该机构首席执行官里奇·戴维 (Rich Davey) 表示，目标是让机场感觉更地道。该竞赛通过现场试镜和在线提交吸引了数千名申请者，参赛者使用专门编写的脚本展示了自己的口音，其中包含波士顿地标、地区美食和当地表达方式。评委们对参赛作品的清晰度、真实性以及对洛根机场氛围的捕捉程度进行了评估。

最终的八名参赛者代表了大波士顿地区的不同背景和社区。其中包括梅根·刘易斯·迈克尔森 (Meagan Lewis-Michelson)，一位音乐剧演员；克里斯托弗·多尼西 (Christopher Donisi)，一名管道安装工；菲利斯·蒂博多·比奇 (Phyllis Thibodeaux Beach)，机动车辆部门退休员工；亚历克斯·马尔辛 (Alex Marcin) 是来自东波士顿的第三代意大利裔美国人。剩下的决赛入围者是波士顿公立学校教师阿什利·库克 (Ashley Cook)；萨曼莎·爱德华兹，企业家； Max German，波士顿学院法学院学生；克里斯汀·英加拉 (Kristin Ingala) 是一名调酒师和拳击手，在波士顿北区长大。公众投票将于 10 月 24 日至 28 日在 VoiceofLogan.com 网站上进行，获胜者将于 11 月 5 日公布。
获胜者将因录制公告而获得少量报酬，尽管这个机会主要是为了当地的自豪感而不是经济奖励。这场比赛让参与者有机会拥抱自己的根源，同时竞争一个可以让数百万乘客熟悉他们的声音的角色。
数千人试镜寻找波士顿最地道的口音
试镜脚本旨在测试参赛者对波士顿的了解及其发音。它参考了龙虾卷、北区的奶油甜馅煎饼卷、沿海小镇格洛斯特和芬威公园著名的绿色怪物。一项特别重要的测试是正确发音格洛斯特，戴维强调，当用明显的当地口音发音时，这个名字应该听起来像“GLOS-tah”。据《华尔街日报》报道，马萨诸塞州交通运输规划经理莎拉·李（Sarah Lee）审查了大约 500 份录音，并表示，不正确的发音可能会暴露口音不真实的申请人。

比赛还吸引了高调的投稿和大量的幽默。马萨诸塞州参议员埃德·马基和前新英格兰爱国者队近端锋罗布·格隆考斯基录制了他们自己的版本，而演员本·阿弗莱克则提交了一段戏仿作品，其中对波士顿的刻板印象进行了半开玩笑的警告。与此同时，配音教练兼播音员克里斯·巴勒莫（Chris Palermo）为参赛者提供了一些非传统的建议，以重现这座城市特有的演讲模式。提交的各种材料表明，尽管居民与波士顿口音有着不同的关系，但波士顿口音仍然是该地区文化特征中可识别的一部分。
另一个重要的考虑因素是平衡区域特征与机场通信的实际要求。据《华尔街日报》报道，洛根机场每天为大约 130,000 名乘客提供服务，因此在航站楼噪音和乘客流动中，清晰度至关重要。独特的口音可以让机场感觉更加热情和难忘，但不熟悉当地语言的游客仍然必须理解重要的指示。获胜的声音必须在个性与清晰度之间取得平衡，同时又不能带有最强的口音。
从卡罗琳·霍普金斯到洛根：机场公告背后的声音
机场公告通常使用熟悉的专业声音，而不是当地的个人声音。卡罗琳·霍普金斯就是最著名的例子之一：这位美国配音艺术家为数百个交通设施和其他公共场所录制了公告。正如 The Points Guy 在 WBUR 采访中描述霍普金斯的职业生涯一样，她冷静、友好的表达方式已为众多机场、火车站和其他公共场所的旅客所熟悉。她的职业生涯说明了录音如何成为乘客体验中持久的（尽管大部分是匿名的）一部分。
洛根的做法采取了不同的方向，故意选择与其家乡相关的声音。 Massport 并没有优先考虑标准化的公告风格，而是邀请公众选择口音和个性反映周围社区的人。该举措可以使机场的日常信息更加独特，同时为当地居民提供代表波士顿的不同寻常的机会。获胜者预计将在今年晚些时候的假期期间开始欢迎游客。
对于波士顿来说，比赛不仅仅是找人通过公共广播系统朗读剧本。这是一个将熟悉的地方口音转变为公民自豪感的象征并赋予洛根更容易识别的当地身份的机会。无论选民喜欢微妙的口音还是特别强调的表达方式，获胜的声音很快就会成为新英格兰最繁忙的机场之一的配乐的一部分。

Four pilots were killed when two Philippine Air Force SF-260 trainer aircraft collided in mid-air at Fernando Air Base, south of Manila, on Friday afternoon.

Both single-engine propeller aircraft came down within the base perimeter, with no casualties reported on the ground, Air Force spokesman Colonel Alvin Capinguian said in a statement released on Saturday.
The air force has opened an investigation into the collision and temporarily grounded its SF-260 fleet as a precaution. The circumstances of the accident have not been established.
The crash follows another fatal SF-260 training accident in May, when two military pilots were killed in Benguet province in the northern Philippines.

body_en: Western Sydney Airport welcomes first passenger flights - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Western Sydney Airport (WSI) Western Sydney Airport welcomes first passenger flights
Western Sydney International Airport opened to passengers on Sunday, 25 October, with a sold-out Jetstar service to the Gold Coast marking its first commercial departure.

Flight JQ362 took off shortly before 11:30 local time, following the opening of check-in at 08:00. A return service from the Gold Coast was scheduled to arrive at 15:00, followed by the airport’s first Melbourne departure at 18:00.

Located at Badgerys Creek, approximately 45 kilometres from central Sydney, the airport operates around the clock, offering an alternative to the curfew-restricted Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport. Cargo operations began in July.

Chief executive Simon Hickey described the opening as a generational change for Australian aviation. The initial terminal can handle about ten million passengers a year, a level the airport expects to reach in the early to mid-2030s.

Longer-term development, including additional terminals and a second runway, could increase capacity to 82 million passengers a year in the 2060s. These figures represent potential future capacity rather than opening-year traffic forecasts.

Hickey said passengers could have access to more than 250 destinations through connecting airline networks within just over a year. That figure includes onward connections and does not represent the number of nonstop routes from Western Sydney.

Approximately 10,000 people worked on the airport’s construction, around half from Western Sydney. The airport estimates that up to 8,500 jobs will support operations across the precinct once annual passenger numbers reach ten million.

body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. summary: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017

body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. The first prototype VT35 has completed final assembly and is now undergoing flight testing, with the first public flight occurring in December 2025. Certification will be with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC), as with EHang’s EH216-S, and certification is expected to be accelerated owing to the company’s experience certifying the previous model. Structure and Powertrain The VT35 seats two passengers inside a cabin featuring panoramic viewing windows. Each fan is individually powered by it’s own electric motor. Distributed electric propulsion (DEP) is the name given to this method of powering aircraft. No critical points of failure provide a high level of redundancy and will ensure safety onboard. The aircraft design was originally developed by Volkswagen China and was transferred to Diamond following a deal between the two companies in February 2024. A subscale prototype of the V.MO first flew in 2022. The full-scale aircraft design was unveiled at the Zhuhai Airshow in November 2024. No official certification plans have been announced. Structure and Powertrain The V.MO seats a pilot and four passengers in a streamlined cabin. The aircraft features a twin-boom connected by fore and aft wings, with eight vertical lift fans distributed along the booms. The aircraft features two pusher propellers, providing propulsion during wing-borne cruise flight. The aircraft features distributed electric propulsion (DEP), with each propeller powered by its own electric motor. This design approach provides high redundancy and reliability by eliminating critical points of failure. body_en: Zero Gravity ZG-T6 william.moore@… Wed, 07/02/2025 - 09:51 The ZG-T6 is a tiltrotor eVTOL concept being developed by Zero Gravity Aircraft Industry. It is designed for both passenger transport and urban air cargo missions and is set to enter into service in 2028. Certification is expected to come from the Civil Aviation Authority of China (CAAC). Structure and Powertrain The aircraft is designed to seat one pilot and five passengers inside a carbon fiber composite cabin with panoramic wrap-around windows for enhanced visibility. It is equipped with six tiltrotors powered by six electric motors, allowing for vertical takeoff and landing, and forward flight. title_en: Aer Lingus Completes Free Starlink Wi-Fi Rollout On Long Haul Fleet
title_zh: 爱尔兰航空在长途机队完成免费 Starlink Wi-Fi 部署
summary: Aer Lingus has installed free Starlink Wi-Fi on all 12 A330s and 14 A321s, finishing its long haul rollout well ahead of schedule. Short haul planes are next.
summary_zh: 爱尔兰航空已在所有 12 架 A330 和 14 架 A321 上安装了免费的 Starlink Wi-Fi，提前完成了远程部署。短途飞机
body_en: In November 2025, International Airlines Group (IAG) announced plans to introduce free Starlink Wi-Fi across the brand’s airlines, including British Airways, Iberia, and Aer Lingus.

In March 2026, we saw Aer Lingus equip its first aircraft (an Airbus A330) with Starlink Wi-Fi. There’s now an exciting update for the airline, as all long haul planes now feature the service. That’s fantastic news for those traveling transatlantic on the airline.

Aer Lingus is partnering with SpaceX to introduce Starlink Wi-Fi throughout its fleet, including on long haul and short haul aircraft. Best of all, Aer Lingus is offering Starlink Wi-Fi for free for all passengers. With this system, it’s possible to connect with multiple devices, including laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

Aer Lingus doesn’t even require you to be a member of its loyalty program in order to use the service, which is an area where IAG carriers are (generously) countering the industry trend, as other airlines are using Starlink as a way to drive loyalty program sign-ups.

Starlink is known for its high-speed, low-latency broadband internet, and the service is offered gate to gate. Starlink Wi-Fi allows for live streaming, productivity similar to on the ground (with high upload and download speeds), gaming, e-commerce, and more. Starlink is becoming increasingly popular with airlines, and we’ve seen dozens of airlines sign up for the service. As a passenger who values staying connected, I find Starlink to be a game changer .

Aer Lingus has just revealed that it has now installed Starlink Wi-Fi on all of its long haul aircraft. This includes all 12 Airbus A330s, as well as all 14 Airbus A321s (including both the A321LR and A321XLR variants). That means that all of Aer Lingus’ long haul fleet now features Starlink Wi-Fi.

The airline deserve huge credit for that rollout pace. Initially the carrier was planning on having Starlink on all long haul flights by the first quarter of 2027, then the timeline was moved forward to the end of 2026, and now the project has been wrapped up before the end of October. Kudos!
That’s the beauty of Starlink, because the actual installation process is really quick, once planes are certified to have the service.

With long haul aircraft now reconfigured, the plan is for short haul aircraft operating within Europe to get Starlink next, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. The airline has a total of 27 Airbus A320s and eight Airbus A320neos, so once that project starts, I’d expect it to only take a few months to complete, at most.

Aer Lingus is in the process of rolling out free Starlink Wi-Fi, and has done an impressive job so far. At this point all long haul aircraft, including Airbus A330s, A321LRs, and A321XLRs, feature Starlink. This is well ahead of the planned timeline, which was supposed to see the project complete by the first quarter of 2027.

Next up we can expect to see short haul Aer Lingus planes get Starlink, though the timeline for that remains to be seen. Unlike non-IAG carriers, Aer Lingus isn’t requiring passengers to be a member of the loyalty program to connect to the service.

title_en: My Current Credit Card Portfolio: 26 Cards, $7,979 In Annual Fees (Ouch!)
title_zh: 我当前的信用卡组合：26 张卡，年费 7,979 美元（哎呀！）
summary: I currently have 26 credit cards open. Here's every card in my wallet, its annual fee, why I keep it, and which ones I plan to cancel.
summary_zh: 我目前有 26 张信用卡。这是我钱包中的每张卡、其年费、我保留它的原因以及我计划取消哪些卡。
body_en: It goes without saying that some of us take maximizing credit card rewards to the extreme, and that can include holding onto a lot of credit cards. In this post, I’d like to lay my cards on the table… no pun intended!

After all, maximizing credit cards is one of the best ways to elevate your travel. This can include getting the credit cards with the best welcome bonuses , maximizing your return on spending , and taking advantage of credit card perks .

There are a lot of misconceptions about the impact that applying for credit cards can have on your credit score. So I’d like to first address how applying for credit cards impacts your credit score (I have lots of cards, and my score is excellent), then I’ll talk about what goes into my credit card decision making process, and then I’ll share the cards I currently have open.

There are a lot of misconceptions about how credit scores work, in particular people thinking that applying for credit cards hurts your credit score . That’s generally not true, and in many cases applying for cards can even help your credit score in the long run.
For context, I have a lot of credit cards, and my credit score is almost perfect , in the top couple percent nationwide.
For those of you not familiar, here’s what factors into your credit score
35% of your score is your payment history (the percentage of payments you’ve made on-time)
30% of your score is your credit utilization (how much credit you’re using compared to your total limits)
15% of your score is your credit age (the average age of your open accounts)
10% of your score is the types of credit you use (how many different types of requests for credit you have)
10% of your score is your requests for new credit (how many times you’ve applied for credit)

What’s most important is that you pay your bills on time, don’t utilize too much of your credit (meaning you want to ideally use 20% or less of your total available credit, and/or pay your credit card bills early ), and keep some cards long term, which will help increase your average age of accounts.

The only metric that’s lowered by applying for cards is your requests for new credit, but that makes up just 10% of your score. Furthermore, credit inquiries typically fall off your report after 24 months.
Closing credit cards that are no longer working for you potentially doesn’t harm your credit much either, though alternatively you can also often downgrade credit cards instead .
What I look for when applying for credit cards
For me, there are three things I look for when applying for credit cards
Credit cards that offer a big welcome bonus — often the introductory bonuses on cards are compelling, and enough reason to pick up a new card

Credit cards that offer a generous return on spending — there are some cards you have because they help you maximize the points you earn , whether it’s for everyday spending, for specific spending categories , or for large purchases

Credit cards that offer perks that more than justify the annual fee — some cards are worth holding onto even if you don’t plan on putting much spending on them, because they offer things like elite status , annual free nights , etc.

就背景而言，我有很多信用卡，而且我的信用评分几乎是完美的，在全国排名前几位。
对于那些不熟悉的人，以下是影响您的信用评分的因素

分数的 30% 是您的信用利用率（您使用的信用量与总限额相比）

您的分数的 10% 是您使用的信用类型（您有多少种不同类型的信用请求）

申请信用卡会降低的唯一指标是您对新信用的请求，但这仅占您分数的 10%。此外，信用查询通常会在 24 个月后从您的报告中消失。
关闭不再对您有用的信用卡可能也不会对您的信用造成太大损害，尽管您也可以经常降级信用卡。
申请信用卡时我要寻找什么

提供巨额欢迎奖金的信用卡——通常卡上的介绍性奖金很有吸引力，并且有足够的理由选择一张新卡

body_en: Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045 - Aviation24.be
Home Manufacturers Airbus Airbus forecasts 46% growth in global freighter fleet by 2045

Airbus expects the worldwide dedicated freighter fleet to grow from 2,360 aircraft in 2026 to 3,460 by 2045, an increase of approximately 46%, driven by fleet replacement and expanding air cargo demand.

Its 2026 Cargo Global Market Forecast, presented at the Cargo Facts Symposium, estimates a requirement for 2,670 freighter deliveries over the period. Replacements will account for 1,580 aircraft, with a further 1,090 supporting growth.

Passenger-to-freighter conversions are expected to supply 1,700 aircraft, compared with 970 new-build freighters. By size, demand comprises 1,140 single-aisle aircraft, 860 medium widebodies and 670 large widebodies.

North America will lead demand with 925 deliveries, followed by Asia-Pacific with 850. Together, the regions represent approximately two-thirds of the total. Europe and the CIS will require 515 aircraft, Latin America 165, the Middle East 125 and Africa 90.

Airbus forecasts annual air cargo traffic growth of 3.2% over the next two decades, outpacing projected global trade growth of 2.9%. It identifies e-commerce, high-value technology shipments and the use of air freight as an alternative to maritime transport among the principal drivers.

Asia-Pacific is expected to remain the leading region for international air cargo traffic, with North American connections forming the largest market. Airbus sees opportunities for its A350F and passenger-to-freighter conversions across the A320, A321 and A330 families as operators replace older aircraft.

body_en: American posts record revenue but fuel costs drive third-quarter loss - Aviation24.be
American Airlines reported record third-quarter revenue of US$16.3 billion, up 19.3% year-on-year, but higher fuel costs pushed the group to a net loss of US$269 million.

The airline’s fuel bill increased by US$1.9 billion, or 67.5%, compared with the third quarter of 2025. Its adjusted net loss was US$182 million, while unit costs excluding fuel and special items rose by 3%.

Revenue growth extended across cabins and markets. Premium revenue increased by 22.9% and Main Cabin revenue by 19.5%, while total revenue per available seat kilometre rose by 14.5%. International passenger unit revenue grew by 16.4%, led by Latin America, ahead of a 13.6% increase domestically.

Business travel also remained strong, with managed corporate revenue rising by 27.6%, its sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Enrolments in the AAdvantage loyalty programme increased by 27.4%.

American is continuing investment in premium seating, lounges and onboard technology. It plans to extend Starlink connectivity across its entire mainline fleet of more than 1,000 aircraft and introduce seatback entertainment on new narrowbody deliveries from 2028. A narrowbody retrofit programme is intended to raise premium seating to 40% of seats in the coming years.
The group ended September with US$11.8 billion in available liquidity. It expects its efficiency programme to deliver nearly US$1 billion in annualised savings by the end of 2026.

For the fourth quarter, American forecasts revenue growth of 19.5–22.5%, but anticipates a further US$2.8 billion year-on-year increase in fuel expense, based on the forward fuel curve as of 19 October. Elevated fuel prices are also expected to slow network growth in 2027 compared with 2026.

title_en: Alaska Atmos Rewards Summit Card Review: My Favorite Airline Credit Card
title_zh: 阿拉斯加Atmos奖励峰会卡评论：我最喜欢的航空公司信用卡

body_en: The Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card is the premium personal credit card of Atmos Rewards, which is the combined loyalty program of Alaska Airlines & Hawaiian Airlines. This card is issued by Bank of America, and has to be one of the best value premium cards we’ve ever seen.

This post is my in-depth Atmos Rewards Summit Card review, so let’s take a look at all of the details of the card, including the overall value proposition, for anyone who may be considering applying. This is a particularly good time to pick up the card, given the bonus that’s currently available.
Link: Learn more about the Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card
Atmos Rewards Summit Card summary & key details
Before I get into my Atmos Rewards Summit Card review, here’s a brief summary of the key details of the card
Atmos Summit Card welcome offer: 100,000 Atmos Rewards points plus a 25K-point Global Companion Award after spending $6,000 within the first 90 days

Atmos Summit Card rewards earn rate: 3x Atmos Rewards points on Alaska & Hawaiian purchases, foreign purchases, and dining purchases, and 1x points on all other purchases; also earn one status point for every $2 spent, with no cap

Atmos Summit Card benefits & credits: Anniversary 25K-point Global Companion Award, waived partner award booking fees, free points sharing, up to eight Alaska Lounge passes annually, first checked bag free on Alaska & Hawaiian, preferred boarding on Alaska & Hawaiian flights, and much more
Atmos Summit Card foreign transaction fees: None
Atmos Summit Card best for: Anyone who flies Alaska or Hawaiian with any frequency, and/or values award redemptions on oneworld airlines
Below are what I consider to be the pros and cons of the Atmos Rewards Summit Card .

Atmos Rewards Summit Card pros Atmos Rewards Summit Card cons Incredibly lucrative welcome bonus Steep annual fee The best rate for Atmos Rewards status points Lounge access that’s limited to twice per quarter Very strong ongoing perks that justify the annual fee Perks are largely specific to Alaska & Hawaiian, which isn’t a huge airline Useful bonus categories for spending Less flexibility with rewards than earning transferable points Atmos Rewards Summit Card bonus, eligibility, & fees

The Atmos Rewards Summit Card is the premium personal card in the Atmos Rewards ecosystem. To start, let’s cover the welcome bonus, eligibility rules, annual fee, and more. After all, these are major considerations for anyone considering opening a credit card.
Limited time bonus of 100K points & Global Companion Award

The Atmos Rewards Summit Card is currently offering a limited time welcome bonus , in line with the best-ever offer that we’ve seen on the card. With the Atmos Summit Card bonus, cardmembers can earn 100,000 bonus points and a 25,000-point Global Companion Award after spending $6,000 within the first 90 days.

Based on my latest miles & points valuations , I consider Atmos Rewards points to be worth 1.5 cents each, given the great uses of these rewards . That means I value the 100,000 points at $1,500. On top of that, the Global Companion Award can be used to take 25,000 points off the cost of a companion award ticket, and I’d consider that to be worth pretty close to face value ($375). So with a total value of $1,875, I consider this to be among the best credit card welcome offers out there .

The Atmos Rewards Summit Card is issued by Bank of America. The good news is that eligibility for this card is unrelated to having any other Atmos Rewards card, so you’re eligible for this card (including the bonus) if you have another Atmos Rewards product, like the Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® credit card ( learn more ) or Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card ( learn more ).
Let me emphasize that you are eligible for this product if you have any of the previously issued Alaska Mileage Plan Bank of America cards, or HawaiianMiles Barclays cards.

Bank of America doesn’t have too many consistent restrictions when it comes to getting approved for cards. There are a couple of policies regarding personal cards that are worth being aware of (which don’t impact business cards)

Bank of America has the 2/3/4 rule, meaning you can open at most two Bank of America cards every two months, at most three Bank of America cards every 12 months, and at most four Bank of America cards every 24 months
